::: {.lead}
What a person sees while Longhaul works: every task, its timeline turn by turn, and the forms to steer it.
:::

The console is a React, Vite and TypeScript app in `console/` (ADR-0011). It reads the console API and nothing else, so it can show a task and send it a signal, but it cannot touch a sandbox or GitHub. It also has the memory viewer, where a person approves or rejects the notes the agent wants to keep.

The screenshots come from the Phase 8 and Phase 9 gates. They were taken with Playwright against the demo stack, which runs the scripted provider, so every cost on them is $0.00.

## Tasks

![The tasks list: each row shows the task's phase, turns, cost and outcome, and the two tasks that wait on a person say what they need.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-9/1-tasks-1280.png){.screenshot}

The tasks list polls every 10 seconds. The "Needs you" filter keeps the tasks that wait on a person: a paused task and a task whose plan waits for approval.

![The Needs you filter: the task waiting on its plan and the paused task.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-8/2-needs-you.png){.screenshot}

## One task, turn by turn

![A shipped task: summary, plan with its steps done, every turn and tool call, the verdict and the outcome.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-8/3-timeline.png){.screenshot}

![A shipped task: each event reads as one line (step updates with the short sha, the verdict, the outcome), with a checkpoint marker on the turn that made it.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-9/2-timeline-1280.png){.screenshot}

![A stuck task: the failing test runs show as failed with their exit code, then the stuck line with its evidence and the question the task paused on.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-9/4-stuck-1280.png){.screenshot}

The task page shows the summary (phase, cost, turns, tokens, cache ratio, pull request, and the plan with the status of each step) and the timeline. The timeline groups the rows by turn with the tool calls inside, marks each checkpoint on the turn that made it, and colours the events by type: compaction, pause, hint, verdict, recovery and error.

## Steer a task

![A paused task with the hint, budget and cancel forms.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-8/4-actions.png){.screenshot}

Approve plan and Reject plan show while a task waits on its plan. Send hint, Add budget and Cancel task show until the task ends. For a task of an issue, the workflow repeats each action as a short comment on the issue, so the issue shows every steer.

## Memory

![The memory viewer on the candidates tab.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-8/5-memory.png){.screenshot}

A note that the agent drafts is a candidate, and only approved notes reach a prompt (ADR-0010). The memory page shows the approved, candidate and rejected notes of one repo, and a person approves or rejects a candidate here.

## Sign in, and small screens

![The sign-in page.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-8/6-login.png){.screenshot}

The console asks for the admin token of the API and keeps it only after the API accepts it.

![The tasks list at 375 px: the first column says the phase and what the task needs, and the table scrolls inside its box.](_generated/docs/gates/media/phase-9/5-tasks-375.png){.screenshot .screenshot-narrow}
